shared_elements: small figures with splayed/outstretched limbs arranged in a row
long horizontal line or band spanning the surface
isolated small marks/dots filling the field
monochrome design on a natural rock surface
justification: The most specific correspondence is a long horizontal line running across the upper field with a row of small limbed figures ranged beneath it, plus an isolated disc motif in each; both also scatter small detached marks around the main figures. Otherwise they are wholly unalike: A is deeply carved low relief in stacked, framed registers with volumetric, naturalistically observed animals, while B is a flat, thin-lined red painting of schematic stick-like forms freely dispersed on an unframed rock face.
